agent_roles.planner: Opus 4.8 — Creates plans only, never writes code.

features.title: Base workout tracker UI
features.user_visible_behavior: User sees a dark-themed gym tracker with weekly schedule, exercise list, set tracking with checkmarks, and week navigation.
features.evidence: Build succeeds. App renders with workout data. Sets can be checked/unchecked.

features.title: Dual-layer persistent storage
features.user_visible_behavior: User's checked sets persist across page reloads. Works in both Apps Script and local browser.
features.verification: Check sets, reload page, verify sets remain checked.
features.evidence: localStorage fallback works locally. Apps Script PropertiesService works in deployment.
features.notes: Uses window.storage (Apps Script) with localStorage fallback.

features.title: Google Apps Script deployment
features.user_visible_behavior: App is accessible via a Google Apps Script web app URL.
features.verification: Copy dist/index.html into Code.gs doGet() HtmlService. Deploy and access URL.
features.evidence: Deployed and functional after fixing IIFE build and script placement.
features.notes: Superseded by PLAN-001. Old config preserved in vite.config.appsscript.js. Deploy target is now Vercel.

features.title: PWA manifest & service worker
features.user_visible_behavior: App can be installed on mobile home screen. Shows app icon and splash screen. Works offline with cached assets.
features.verification: Lighthouse PWA audit score >= 90. Install prompt appears on mobile Chrome.
features.evidence: Reviewer verified: npm run build produces dist/manifest.webmanifest (valid, 3 icons), dist/sw.js (Workbox precache 15 entries), dist/registerSW.js. index.html links manifest and registers SW. init.sh exits 0. Commit f222ef6.
features.notes: Implemented via vite-plugin-pwa with registerType:autoUpdate. Full Lighthouse audit pending Vercel deploy.

features.title: Offline support
features.user_visible_behavior: App functions without internet connection. Cached workout data is accessible offline.
features.verification: Disconnect network in DevTools. App still loads and shows workout data.
features.evidence: Reviewer verified: Workbox precaches 15 entries (449.57 KiB), navigateFallback:/index.html configured, cleanupOutdatedCaches:true. Offline test pending live deploy.
features.notes: Implemented via Workbox in vite-plugin-pwa. Full offline test requires served environment (npm run preview or Vercel).

features.title: Exercise editing — add/remove/reorder exercises
features.user_visible_behavior: User can add custom exercises, remove existing ones, and reorder them within a day.
features.verification: Add exercise, verify it appears. Remove exercise, verify it disappears. Reorder and verify new order persists.
features.evidence: Reviewer verified: ./init.sh exits 0. npm run build generates clean React PWA bundle. resolveSession handles base exercise reconciliation and filters out deleted exercises. Reordering buttons (↑/↓) change position, disable correctly on endpoints, and write to sessionExercises in local storage. Legacy migration from custom/addedEx/deletedEx succeeds on startup with no data loss.
features.notes: Currently exercises are hardcoded in MAIN/MANT arrays. PLAN-002 unifies custom/addedEx/deletedEx + order into a single sessionExercises structure and adds ↑/↓ reordering. Executor reassigned v0→codex (state/storage refactor); visual drag-and-drop polish could be a later v0 plan.

features.title: Workout history & statistics
features.user_visible_behavior: User can view past weeks' completion rates, exercise streaks, and progress charts.
features.verification: Navigate to history view. Verify charts show correct data from stored weeks.
features.notes: Depends on accumulated stored data across multiple weeks.

features.title: Rest timer with notification
features.user_visible_behavior: User taps a rest timer button after completing a set. Timer counts down and vibrates/notifies when rest is over.
features.verification: Start timer. Verify countdown displays. Verify vibration/notification fires at 0.

features.title: Weight/rep logging per set
features.user_visible_behavior: User can log specific weight and reps for each set, not just check/uncheck completion.
features.verification: Tap a set, enter weight/reps. Reload. Verify values persist.
features.notes: Requires schema change in stored data format.

features.title: Onboarding flow
features.user_visible_behavior: First-time users see a brief welcome screen explaining how to use the app before seeing the workout tracker.
features.verification: Clear storage. Open app. Verify onboarding appears. Complete it. Verify tracker loads. Reload — onboarding should not reappear.

features.title: Brutalist cream redesign + larger touch targets
features.user_visible_behavior: The app uses a brutalist cream theme (cream background, thick black borders, hard shadows, high contrast) and the buttons — especially the bottom navigation bar — are large and comfortable to tap on mobile (>= 48px touch targets).
features.verification: Open app on a phone-sized viewport. Verify cream brutalist styling across Hoy/Semana/Correr and that bottom nav + main buttons are large and easy to tap.
features.evidence: Executor verified: cream/pastel brutalist theme renders consistently in Hoy/Semana/Correr at 390x844; bottom nav and primary controls are >=48px; ./init.sh and npm run build exit 0; browser console has zero errors.
features.notes: All styles are inline in src/GymTracker.jsx (tokens lines 22-27). Bottom nav lines 633-640 is too small today. Planned in PLAN-003.

features.title: Per-set completion tracking for strength exercises
features.user_visible_behavior: Tapping a strength exercise opens a focused view where the user marks each set individually (1 of N at a time) instead of completing all sets at once. Partial progress persists and is reflected in the rings.
features.verification: Tap a strength exercise, mark sets one by one, reload, verify partial progress persists and the exercise only completes when all sets are marked.
features.evidence: Executor verified: strength exercise opens focused per-set sheet; marking 1/4 persists after reload and updates session/week percentages; test data restored afterward. setProgress is the only completion key written; legacy done remains read-only migration input.
features.notes: UI is V0; the data-model change (done bool -> setProgress count, migration, weekly reset) is a delimited Codex lane inside PLAN-003. Replaces the single toggle (line 568).

features.title: Warmup (Calentamiento) exercise category
features.user_visible_behavior: When creating or editing an exercise, the user can choose a 'Calentamiento' (warmup) category in addition to Fuerza, Cardio and Plyo.
features.verification: Open the add-exercise form, select Calentamiento, save, verify it persists with its own color/label.
features.evidence: Executor verified: Calentamiento appears in both add and edit selectors with its own pastel token and supports sets.
features.notes: Add 'warmup' to T_CLR/T_LBL (lines 92-93) and the type selector in AddExForm (lines 152-157). Planned in PLAN-003.

features.title: Edit exercise name
features.user_visible_behavior: The exercise edit form lets the user change the exercise name, in addition to the existing sets/reps/target fields. The new name persists across reloads.
features.verification: Edit an exercise, change its name, save, reload, verify the new name persists and shows the 'editado' indicator.
features.evidence: Executor verified: changed a base exercise name, saved, reloaded, and confirmed the name plus editado indicator persisted through sessionExercises.overrides; reset restored the test data.
features.notes: ExCard edit form (lines 244-267) lacks a name field today. Name persisted via override (sessionExercises.overrides[id].name from PLAN-002, or custom[id].name fallback). Planned in PLAN-003.
